title: Hearty Steam American Collards Hash
description: Nutty, shaggy, adventurous American dish featuring collards, steam, and a mix of savory flavors.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Add the diced red bell pepper and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the collard greens, salt, black pepper, and smoked paprika to the skillet.
Stir well to combine and cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the greens have wilted slightly.
Add the diced potatoes to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cover the skillet with a lid and steam the mixture for 10-12 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender.
Uncover the skillet and stir the mixture well to redistribute the potatoes and collard greens.
Continue to cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the potatoes are lightly browned.
Serve the Hearty Steam American Collards Hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
